notionImport.title: Import from Notion
notionImport.noScope: Importing needs the Imports permission, which you do not have. Ask an administrator of your organisation to give it to you.
notionImport.how1: In Notion, open Settings, then Export all workspace content.
notionImport.how2: Choose Markdown & CSV, and include subpages and files.
notionImport.how3: Notion emails you a link to a zip. Download it, then choose it here as it is, without unzipping it.
notionImport.nothingYet: Nothing is created before you have seen the preview.
notionImport.reading: Reading the export. A large one can take a few minutes.
notionImport.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Choose it again to continue where it stopped.

refusal.pdf: This is a PDF. The import reads the zip Notion makes with Markdown & CSV.
refusal.html: This is a web page. The import reads the zip Notion makes with Markdown & CSV.
refusal.notZip: This is not a zip. Choose the zip Notion emailed you, without unzipping it.
refusal.htmlExport: This export is in HTML. Export again from Notion and choose Markdown & CSV.
refusal.noPages: This zip holds no pages from a Notion export. Export again from Notion and choose Markdown & CSV.
refusal.encrypted: This zip has a password. Export again from Notion, or zip the files without a password.
refusal.zipBomb: This zip expands to far more than its size, so it was not opened. Export again from Notion.
refusal.tooManyEntries: This zip holds too many files. Export one top page and its subpages at a time.
refusal.unsafeEntry: This zip holds a file whose path points outside the zip, so it was not opened.
refusal.unsupportedMethod: This zip uses a compression the import cannot read. Use the zip Notion made, or zip the files again.
refusal.tooLarge: This upload is over 1 GB. Export one top page and its subpages at a time.
refusal.nestedTooDeep: This zip holds zips inside zips. The import reads one zip, or a zip of zips, no deeper.
refusal.forbidden: You cannot import here: you need the Imports permission and the right to create pages and folders. Ask an administrator.
refusal.other: The export could not be read. Try again, or export again from Notion.

notionImport.storageLeft: Your organisation has {{left}} of storage left.
notionImport.storageShort: This export is larger than the storage left: files that do not fit are listed in the report.
notionImport.allComes: Everything in this export comes across.

notionImport.undoNoScope: Undoing an import needs the Undo imports permission. Ask an administrator.

notionImport.undoFailed: The import could not be undone. Try again.
